caveats: Requires remote admin configured (cfg.Admin.Remote != nil) and two config reloads close together (e.g. two concurrent admin API requests); net/http per-request handler goroutine behaviour is outside the tree.
subclaims.reason: replaceRemoteAdminServer assigns the package global remoteAdminServer (R6/admin.go:472) but the Serve goroutine it spawns reads the same global (R6/admin.go:491) instead of a local copy. Concurrent reloads arrive on distinct net/http admin-handler goroutines via handleAdminRequest (R6/admin.go:864) and serialize on currentCfgMu (R6/caddy.go:133), so reload B's write can land after reload A spawns G-A but before G-A is scheduled. G-A's read then observes server B and calls B.Serve on A's listener ln while B's stop path shuts down A, which never served: a crossed generation. No lock is held on the read side (the only mutex in R6/admin.go is an unrelated sync.Pool at R6/admin.go:1218), and goroutine creation orders G-A only after A's write, not after B's write, so nothing rules the interleaving out.
